origin.description: Minimize the sum of squares of a residual function with MINPACK lmdif, or lmder when a Jacobian is supplied.
origin.usage: nls.lm(par, lower = NULL, upper = NULL, fn, jac = NULL, control = nls.lm.control(), ...)

arguments.name: par
arguments.text: Numeric starting values, or a list of length-1 parameters.

arguments.name: lower, upper
arguments.text: Bounds of the same length as par. Omitted bounds are -Inf and Inf. Each trial step is clamped into the bounds.

arguments.name: fn
arguments.text: Function of the parameters that returns the residual vector. Further arguments are passed through.

arguments.name: jac
arguments.text: Optional function that returns the Jacobian as a column-major vector of length length(fn(par)) * length(par).

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: List from nls.lm.control. An empty maxfev is replaced with 100 * (length(par) + 1).
Further arguments passed to fn and jac.

origin.details: The fit stops for ftol, ptol, gtol, maxfev, or maxiter. info is the MINPACK code, and a negative info means maxiter was reached. The Hessian is rebuilt from the upper triangle of the factored Jacobian.
origin.value: A list with par, hessian, fvec, info, message, diag, niter, rsstrace, and deviance.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(minpack.lm))
fn <- function(p) c(1 - p[1], 10 * (p[2] - p[1]^2))
nls.lm(par = c(-1.2, 1), fn = fn)

translation.description: Minimize the sum of squares of a residual function with MINPACK lmdif, or lmder when a Jacobian is supplied.
translation.usage: nls_lm(par, fn, jac=None, lower=None, upper=None, control=None, **kwargs)

arguments.name: par
arguments.text: Numeric starting values, or a dict of length-1 parameters.

arguments.name: fn
arguments.text: Function of the parameters that returns the residual vector. Further keyword arguments are passed through.

arguments.name: jac
arguments.text: Optional function that returns the Jacobian as a column-major vector, or as an array with one row per residual.

arguments.name: lower, upper
arguments.text: Bounds of the same length as par. Omitted bounds are -inf and inf. Each trial step is clamped into the bounds.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: Dict from nls_lm_control. An empty maxfev is replaced with 100 * (len(par) + 1).

arguments.name: **kwargs
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to fn and jac.

translation.details: The fit stops for ftol, ptol, gtol, maxfev, or maxiter. info is the MINPACK code, and a negative info means maxiter was reached. The Hessian is rebuilt from the upper triangle of the factored Jacobian.
translation.value: A dict with par, hessian, fvec, info, message, diag, niter, rsstrace, and deviance.
